newsitem.title: USA: NCR, Innovex options to be traded.
newsitem.headline: NCR, Innovex options to be traded.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange said Thursday it will trade options on the listed stock of NCR Corp and the over-the-counter stock of Innovex Inc. The options are to be traded beginning January 2.
NCR, a wholly owned subsidiary of AT&T Corp, will open with strike prices of 30, 35 and 40, with position limits of 7,500 contracts, the exchange said. NCR will be traded under the symbol NCR.A.
The initial expiration months will be January, February, April and July of 1997, it said.

Innovex, which manufactures electrical components, will open with strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with position limits of 10,500 contracts. Initial expiration months will be January, February, May and August of 1997.
